description: A skin infection caused by dermatophyte fungi, commonly called ringworm.

appearance.general: Appearance varies with the body site affected; dermatophyte infections may affect the scalp, body, groin, face, hands, feet, or nails.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss the body site involved and whether there are other fungal infections of the skin, scalp, or nails.
